pyqgis_plugin.name: UPWISE Chat for QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Chat dock for QGIS backed by a long-lived Claude Code CLI session.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A thin chat dock widget for QGIS. Reasoning and tool execution run in a separate long-lived Claude Code CLI process (stream-json in/out), so the plugin reuses an existing Claude Code installation and its subscription authentication. Features streaming chat, a tool-use approval bar, skill preset buttons with prerequisite checks, and UPWISE branding. 0.2.0 adds general-purpose public data collection: the plugin runs its own collection server, so API keys stay out of the model context and never leave the machine. 0.2.1 adds a non-modal key settings panel in the dock and value-based redaction of stored keys in the transcript, the session recording and the diagnostic log. 0.2.3 adds per-cell copy buttons, drag selection of a row range with Ctrl+C, and one-button Markdown export of the whole transcript (redacted, written to a fixed path under the QGIS profile). Requires the Claude Code CLI and, for map control, the QGIS MCP plugin with the UPWISE toolkit.
